name: Action Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Action Electronics Co., Ltd., along with its subsidiaries, primarily operates in the manufacturing, processing, and commercialization of audio-visual electronic products. The company also extends its services to the sales, maintenance, and installation of a diverse range of household appliances, operating both within Taiwan and internationally. Its extensive product line encompasses both large and small household appliances, including televisions, air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, various general household and cooking appliances, medical cosmetology devices, and drainages. Furthermore, it offers essential support services such as after-sale care, logistics, and warehousing. The enterprise also develops and provides specialized audio-visual entertainment products for vehicles, including integrated central control dashboards and vehicle central control multimedia dashboard systems. Moreover, Action Electronics engages in real estate development, alongside the manufacturing and sale of automotive electronic products and their accessories. Founded in 1976, the company maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
